name: Casenote
description: Alan's personal artifact brand. Source of truth is the brand-guidelines skill; this profile only restates the machine-checkable parameters.

notes.series.ceiling: Brand: 'Six categories is the ceiling' and the denylist forbids 'a seventh categorical colour'. --series-other is the residual bucket, not slot 6.
notes.gradient_only: --accent-bright #10b981 measures 2.49:1 on light paper - below even the non-text floor. Gradient partner only.
notes.impeccable.ignoreRules: overused-font: Casenote mandates Inter for headings and UI. Validated choice, not a default - these artifacts land in decks, PDFs and PPTX where webfonts do not resolve.
